evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/httpserver.{cpp,h} to prevent HTTP connection starvation.
rationale: Mitigates slow-loris connection exhaustion where slow byte trickling can hold all RPC slots indefinitely before authentication. The rpc category explicitly emphasizes security of the interface, specifically naming 'resource exhaustion through the HTTP server'. While default binding to localhost lowers immediate exploitability, it addresses a clear denial-of-service vector against local and remote RPC callers.
